articles.title: US and rest of world must follow China’s lead on green energy, says John Kerry
articles.highlight: 美国前国务卿约翰·克里表示，中国在摆脱化石燃料方面领先世界，包括美国在内的其他国家现在必须跟进。
articles.summary: 文章报道，克里在COP31开幕之际对《卫报》表示，多数国家“步履蹒跚”，而北京已“大幅加速”绿色能源转型。中国在2026年3月通过的五年规划中首次承诺“积极参与并引领全球气候治理”，COP31可能成为观察其是否付诸行动的首个窗口。这值得关注，因为它涉及中国在全球气候治理中的角色变化，以及对美国等国家的示范压力。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键看点是承诺能否转化为COP31上的具体行动；中国长期回避领导角色，这次表态的实际分量仍需观察。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Former US secretary of state says most nations are ‘stumbling along’ while Beijing has ‘hugely accelerated’ Cop31 live – latest updates China is leading the world in moving away from fossil fuels , and the rest of the globe – including the US – must now follow, the former US secretary of state John Kerry has told the Guardian, as Cop watchers wonder exactly how China is going to approach this year’s climate summit. As Cop31 opens – this year the climate conference is in Turkey – there is plenty of speculation about whether China will finally step into the leadership role that it has long avoided. In its latest “five-year plan” adopted in March 2026, China for the first time pledged to “actively participate in and lead global climate governance”.

articles.sourceExcerpt: JOURNAL OF LATEX CLASS FILES, VOL. 8, AUGUST 2021 1 ScaleBrain: A Scale-Consistent Framework for EEG Foundation Models Minyu Zhou, Yajing Wu, Yongqiang Tang, Wang Jia and Wensheng Zhang Abstract—Foundation models pre-trained on large unlabeled electroencephalography (EEG) corpora have emerged as a trans- formative paradigm for Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) ap- plications. Recent EEG foundation models have shown that multi-scale representations derived from fixed-length patches can improve EEG representation learning.

en.title: ScaleBrain: A Scale-Consistent Framework for EEG Foundation Models
en.highlight: ScaleBrain targets EEG foundation models with scale consistency, and the abstract notes multi-scale representations from fixed-length patches can improve EEG results.
en.summary: The paper proposes ScaleBrain, a scale-consistent framework for EEG foundation models. The abstract frames large-scale unlabeled EEG pretraining as a transformative paradigm for BCI and notes that multi-scale representations from fixed-length patches can improve EEG performance.
en.failureAnalysis: Only the opening abstract is supplied, with no experimental setup, cross-subject validation, compute cost, or clinical deployment evidence. Deployment risk therefore cannot be assessed, especially robustness under subject variability, noise, and channel changes. Scale consistency and any extra multi-scale computation would also need validation in real BCI settings.

articles.title: aws-emulator
articles.selectionReason: AI source passed freshness and evidence-chain gate: Expert analysis
articles.summary: 这篇文章介绍 AWS 官方推出的本地模拟器 aws-emulator，让开发者无需付费 API 密钥，即可针对本地克隆的多种服务运行测试。项目用 Rust 编写，由大量智能体协作完成，前三周就有 29,684 次提交，目前在 macOS 和 Windows 上仍需依赖 Docker。它值得关注，因为它可能降低云服务测试的成本与门槛，也展示了 agentic engineering 的规模化实践。
articles.failureAnalysis: 关键限制是当前在 macOS 与 Windows 上仍需 Docker；作者希望未来提供单个二进制文件，方便集成到跨语言、跨平台的标准测试套件中。
articles.highlight: AWS 终于推出官方模拟器，可在本地克隆的多种服务上运行测试，无需配置付费 API 密钥。
articles.sourceExcerpt: aws-emulator Finally, an official emulator from AWS to run tests against a local clone of their many different services without having to provision a paid API key to do so. It's written in Rust by a huge swarm of agents - 29,684 commits in the first three weeks of the project. Swaminathan (Swami) Sivasubramanian wrote about how it came to be in a guest post on Werner Vogels' blog.

en.highlight: Finally, an official emulator from AWS to run tests against a local clone of their many different services without having to provision a paid API key to do so.
en.summary: The article covers aws-emulator, an official AWS tool that lets developers test against local clones of many services without a paid API key. It is written in Rust and was built by a large swarm of agents, with 29,684 commits in the first three weeks. It is worth reading because it could lower the cost and friction of cloud testing while showing agentic engineering at scale.
en.failureAnalysis: A key practical constraint is that it currently requires Docker on macOS and Windows; the author hopes a future single binary will make it easier to use in cross-language, cross-platform test suites.
